process NANOMONSV_GET {
    tag "${meta.id}"
    label 'process_high'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://depot.galaxyproject.org/singularity/nanomonsv:0.9.0--pyhdfd78af_0'
        : 'quay.io/biocontainers/nanomonsv:0.9.0--pyhdfd78af_0'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(tumor_bam), path(tumor_bai), path(tumor_parse_files, arity: '8')
    tuple val(meta2), path(control_bam), path(control_bai), path(control_parse_files, arity: '0..8')
    tuple val(meta3), path(ref), path(ref_index)
    path simple_repeat_bed
    path simple_repeat_bed_index
    path control_panel_files, arity: '0..8'

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.nanomonsv.result.txt"), emit: result_txt
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.nanomonsv.result.vcf"), emit: result_vcf
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.nanomonsv.supporting_read.txt"), emit: supporting_read
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.nanomonsv.sbnd.result.txt"), emit: sbnd_result_txt, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}.nanomonsv.sbnd.result.vcf"), emit: sbnd_result_vcf, optional: true
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('nanomonsv'), eval("nanomonsv --version 2>&1 | sed 's/^nanomonsv //'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_nanomonsv

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix  = task.ext.prefix  ?: "${meta.id}"
    prefix2 = task.ext.prefix2 ?: "${meta2.id}"

    def simple_repeat_arg = simple_repeat_bed ? "--simple_repeat_bed ${simple_repeat_bed[0]}" : ""
    def control_args = control_bam ? "--control_bam ${control_bam[0]} --control_prefix ${prefix2}" : ""

    """
    nanomonsv get \\
        ${args} \\
        --processes ${task.cpus} \\
        ${control_args} \\
        ${simple_repeat_arg} \\
        ${prefix} \\
        ${tumor_bam} \\
        ${ref}
    """

    stub:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    echo ${args}

    touch ${prefix}.nanomonsv.result.txt
    touch ${prefix}.nanomonsv.result.vcf
    touch ${prefix}.nanomonsv.supporting_read.txt
    touch ${prefix}.nanomonsv.sbnd.result.txt
    touch ${prefix}.nanomonsv.sbnd.result.vcf
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/nanomonsv/get"
description: "Call somatic structural variants with nanomonsv get using tumor/control\n\
  parse outputs and a reference genome.\n"
keywords:
- "structural variants"
- "nanopore"
- "cancer genome"
- "somatic structural variations"
- "long reads"
tools:
- nanomonsv:
    description: "nanomonsv is a software for detecting somatic structural variations\n\
      from paired (tumor and matched control) cancer genome sequence data.\n"
    homepage: "https://github.com/friend1ws/nanomonsv"
    documentation: "https://github.com/friend1ws/nanomonsv#commands"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/friend1ws/nanomonsv"
    doi: "10.1093/nar/gkad526"
    licence:
    - "GPL v3"
    identifier: ""
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'sample.tumor'\
        \ ]\n"
  - tumor_bam:
      type: "file"
      description: "Tumor aligned BAM file"
      pattern: "*.{bam}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
  - tumor_bai:
      type: "file"
      description: "Tumor BAM index file"
      pattern: "*.{bai}"
      ontologies: []
  - tumor_parse_files:
      type: "file"
      description: "Tumor nanomonsv parse outputs in order:\ninsertion, insertion\
        \ index, deletion, deletion index,\nrearrangement, rearrangement index, bp_info,\
        \ bp_info index.\n"
      pattern: "*.{bed.gz,bed.gz.tbi,bedpe.gz,bedpe.gz.tbi}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3003"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3615"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3616"
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'sample.control'\
        \ ]\n"
  - control_bam:
      type: "file"
      description: "Control aligned BAM file"
      pattern: "*.{bam}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
  - control_bai:
      type: "file"
      description: "Control BAM index file"
      pattern: "*.{bai}"
      ontologies: []
  - control_parse_files:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional control sample nanomonsv parse outputs in order:\ninsertion,\
        \ insertion index, deletion, deletion index,\nrearrangement, rearrangement\
        \ index, bp_info, bp_info index.\nThe parse prefix defaults to `meta2.id`\
        \ and can be overridden with\n`task.ext.prefix2`.\n"
      pattern: "*.{bed.gz,bed.gz.tbi,bedpe.gz,bedpe.gz.tbi}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3003"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3615"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3616"
- - meta3:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing reference information\ne.g. [ id:'genome'\
        \ ]\n"
  - ref:
      type: "file"
      description: "Reference FASTA"
      pattern: "*.{fa,fasta}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
  - ref_index:
      type: "file"
      description: "Reference FASTA index"
      pattern: "*.{fai}"
      ontologies: []
- simple_repeat_bed:
    type: "file"
    description: "Simple repeat BED (bgzipped)"
    pattern: "*.{bed.gz}"
    ontologies:
    - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3003"
    - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3615"
- simple_repeat_bed_index:
    type: "file"
    description: "Index for simple repeat BED"
    pattern: "*.{bed.gz.tbi}"
    ontologies: []
- control_panel_files:
    type: "file"
    description: "Optional control panel nanomonsv parse outputs in order:\ninsertion,\
      \ insertion index, deletion, deletion index,\nrearrangement, rearrangement index,\
      \ bp_info, bp_info index.\nThe optional control panel prefix can be set with\
      \ `task.ext.args`\nusing `--control_panel_prefix`.\n"
    pattern: "*.{bed.gz,bed.gz.tbi,bedpe.gz,bedpe.gz.tbi}"
    ontologies:
    - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3003"
    - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3615"
    - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3616"
output:
  result_txt:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'sample'\
          \ ]\n"
    - ${prefix}.nanomonsv.result.txt:
        type: "file"
        description: "Output variants in text format"
        pattern: "*.nanomonsv.result.txt"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2330"
  result_vcf:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'sample'\
          \ ]\n"
    - ${prefix}.nanomonsv.result.vcf:
        type: "file"
        description: "Output variants in VCF format"
        pattern: "*.nanomonsv.result.vcf"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3016"
  supporting_read:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'sample'\
          \ ]\n"
    - ${prefix}.nanomonsv.supporting_read.txt:
        type: "file"
        description: "Supporting read summary"
        pattern: "*.nanomonsv.supporting_read.txt"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2330"
  sbnd_result_txt:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'sample'\
          \ ]\n"
    - ${prefix}.nanomonsv.sbnd.result.txt:
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional SBND results (text)"
        pattern: "*.nanomonsv.sbnd.result.txt"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2330"
  sbnd_result_vcf:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'sample'\
          \ ]\n"
    - ${prefix}.nanomonsv.sbnd.result.vcf:
        type: "file"
        description: "Optional SBND results (VCF)"
        pattern: "*.nanomonsv.sbnd.result.vcf"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3016"
  versions_nanomonsv:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - nanomonsv:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - nanomonsv --version 2>&1 | sed 's/^nanomonsv //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - nanomonsv:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - nanomonsv --version 2>&1 | sed 's/^nanomonsv //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@manascripts"
maintainers:
- "@manascripts"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
